grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Their Things
instructions: 这是为A1水平学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读转录文本），然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
transcript:
Tom: Hi, Lucy. This is my family photo. We are in the living room.
Lucy: Wow, nice photo. Who are they?
Tom: They are my parents. My father is a teacher. My mother is a nurse.
Lucy: And who is this boy?
Tom: He is my brother. His name is Ben. He has two dogs.
Lucy: Two dogs? What are their names?
Tom: Their names are Max and Milo. They are small and brown.
Lucy: Do you have a pet?
Tom: No, I don't. But my sister has a cat. Her cat is white.
Lucy: What is your sister's name?
Tom: Her name is Anna. She has a big bag. My bag is small.
Lucy: I see. Your family is nice.
Tom: Thank you. We are happy.

questions.explanation: Tom说“Her cat is white.”，所以猫是白色的。

questions.prompt: Tom的妹妹叫什么名字？请用原文中的一个词填空。
questions.explanation: Tom说“Her name is Anna.”，所以妹妹的名字是Anna。

questions.explanation: Tom说“My bag is small.”，所以他的包是小的。

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用“we”表示“我们”，“they”表示“他们”。动词“are”与we和they连用。名词复数通常加-s，如dogs。物主代词my（我的）、your（你的）、his（他的）、her（她的）放在名词前。动词have用于I/you/we/they，has用于he/she/it。
grammar.example: They are my parents. He has two dogs.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：___ are my friends.
选择正确的单词填空：She ___ a cat.
questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，动词用has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：This is ___ bag. (我的)
选择正确的单词填空：I have two ___. (狗)
